blocks.text: GPT-5.5 is a proprietary language model from OpenAI, released on Apr 23, 2026.
At $5 input and $30 output per million tokens, it ranks #35 of 40 for input price, placing it mid-range on input cost.
Its context window of 1.0M tokens ranks #19 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
It targets coding, reasoning, agents workloads.
Throughput is measured at 89 tokens per second (ranked #14 of 23 for throughput).
OpenAI's flagship at launch, since superseded by GPT-5.6 Sol and then GPT-6 Astra; GPT-5.5 Instant became ChatGPT's default for free users May 5 2026.
